name: Batley Foodbank
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank at Batley Community Centre
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network. Provides emergency food parcels and support to local residents in crisis. Open Mondays and Thursdays.

name: Batley Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Wilton Park with 30 plots
months: this garden provides growing space and runs mental health horticulture sessions.

name: Batley Community Fridge
short_description: Community fridge at Batley Library reducing food waste
months: this fridge allows residents to share surplus food. Open Monday-Saturday.
